title: Doozy Vape Co Nectar E-Liquid 10ml
description: Doozy Vape Co’s Nectar is an irresistible blend of fresh, sunny sweet Mango on the inhale, followed by the sweet, crisp taste of Apple on the exhale. A sweet and refreshing fruit vape for any time of day. The 70% Vegetable Glycerine, 30% Propylene Glycol formula makes this eliquid ideal for sub-ohm vaping, producing mighty clouds on top of fantastic flavour and a smooth, comfortable, throat hit. Sub-ohm vaping generally requires the use of high-powered vape kits, including pod vape kits and pod mods with higher power outputs, some pen vape kits and advanced kits .
